# file2_observatory, then an A tap every second from 120 s to 330 s (bubble pop by A: in these runs the pair reaches Good Egg
# at ~100-110 s of game time, the test fall comes 25 s later; taps before the fall only make the player jump). harness2.
# The title ("Press both A and B") shows at ~22 s; the file select at ~44 s; file info at ~58 s; the Observatory ~10 s after Play.
# File 1 (Mario, 0 stars) would start the prologue (storybook), not the Observatory: use file 2.
# (13 Nov: the prefix is the marks-based file2_observatory one; the entry screen made the old absolute presses choose Multiplayer.)
mark title /boot: the title screen has appeared/ ~22
mark entry /entry: screen shown/ ~32
mark single /entry: chose single/ ~35.2
title+8-8.5:A|B           # (old 30 s) A+B on the title
entry+3-3.2:A             # (old 35 s) entry screen: Single Player (its cursor starts there on a fresh mp.cfg)
single+15-23:PX=0.25|PY=0.3   # (old 50-58 s) pointer on file 2 (screen 400,310 of 640x456; pointer -1..1, y down)
single+18-18.2:A          # (old 53 s)
single+31-39:PX=0.52|PY=0.78  # (old 66-74 s) pointer on "Play This File" (485,405)
single+34-34.2:A          # (old 69 s)
